operations.after:
typed_parameter: $ => prec(PREC.typed_parameter, seq(
      $.identifier,
      ':',
      field('type', $.type),
    )),

    _typed_list_splat_parameter: $ => prec(PREC.typed_parameter, seq(
      $.list_splat_pattern,
      ':',
      field('type', $.type),
    )),

    _typed_dictionary_splat_parameter: $ => prec(PREC.typed_parameter, seq(
      $.dictionary_splat_pattern,
      ':',
      field('type', $.type),
    )),

operations.before:
except_clause: $ => seq(
      'except',
      optional(token(prec(1, '*'))),
      optional(choice(
        seq(
          field('value', $.expression),
          optional(seq('as', field('alias', $.expression))),
        ),
        commaSep1(field('value', $.expression)),
      )),
      ':',
      $._suite,
    ),
operations.after:
except_clause: $ => seq(
      'except',
      optional(exceptValue($)),
      ':',
      $._suite,
    ),

    _except_group_clause: $ => seq(
      'except',
      token(prec(1, '*')),
      exceptValue($),
      ':',
      $._suite,
    ),

    // expression without the as_pattern alternative (unparenthesized except target list)
    _except_target: $ => choice(
      $.comparison_operator,
      $.not_operator,
      $.boolean_operator,
      $.lambda,
      $.primary_expression,
      $.conditional_expression,
      $.named_expression,
    ),

type_parameter: $ => seq(
      '[',
      commaSep1($.type),
      optional(','),
      ']',
    ),

    // 3.14 type_params: type_param [type_param_default] (PEP 696), declarations only
    _type_parameter_declaration: $ => seq(
      '[',
      commaSep1(choice($.type, $.default_type_parameter)),
      optional(','),
      ']',
    ),

    default_type_parameter: $ => seq(
      field('name', $.type),
      '=',
      field('value', choice($.type, $.list_splat)),
    ),

    _type_alias_name: $ => choice(
      $.identifier,
      $.keyword_identifier,
      alias($._generic_type_declaration, $.generic_type),
    ),

    _generic_type_declaration: $ => seq(
      choice($.identifier, $.keyword_identifier),
      alias($._type_parameter_declaration, $.type_parameter),
    ),
